definitions.gloss: receipt; written acknowledgment that something has been received
definitions.explanation: A document confirming that goods, money, or documents have been received. Used in both commercial transactions and official procedures.

examples.japanese: {受取証|うけとりしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}ったら→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧{受取証|うけとりしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦サインして→サインする：09864_sainsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please sign the receipt when you receive the package.

examples.japanese: ⟦{確定申告|かくていしんこく}→確定申告：04902_kakuteishinkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{医療費|いりょうひ}→医療費：24692_iryouhi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受取証|うけとりしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}して→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧おいた⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You should keep your medical expense receipts for your tax return.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{受取|うけとり}→受取：04100_uketori⟧ (receipt, receiving) + {証|しょう} (proof, certificate). A formal term for a receipt that proves something was received. In everyday shopping, ⟦レシート→レシート：05291_reshiito⟧ (register receipt) or ⟦{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}→領収書：04697_ryoushuusho⟧ (formal receipt) are far more common. {受取証|うけとりしょう} is used specifically when acknowledging receipt of deliveries, documents, or payments in official contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受取証|うけとりしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦サインする→サインする：09864_sainsuru⟧: to sign a receipt
- {受取証|うけとりしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧: to issue a receipt
- {受取証|うけとりしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}する→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧: to keep/store a receipt
- {受取証|うけとりしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit a receipt

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}→領収書：04697_ryoushuusho⟧: receipt — the most common formal receipt for payments, especially for business expense claims
- ⟦レシート→レシート：05291_reshiito⟧: receipt — the slip printed at a cash register; casual everyday term
- {受領書|じゅりょうしょ}: receipt of goods/documents — synonym, slightly more formal and official
